surface: Showcase Network replay capture timing and document provenance
reproduction: Save a Network recipe for a real page request that fires during initial document load and run it through Patterns.
The replay waits for tabs.onUpdated status=loading, then enables event acceptance and sequentially injects the isolated relay and MAIN-world tap.
Separately, leave a response pending in the old document; after loading begins, let the old response relay before or alongside the new document response.
expected: Replay reliably captures the relevant request, or clearly explains that initial requests may precede interception and offers a retrigger path. A prior document's response cannot satisfy or overwrite a run for the new document; trusted document identity is required in addition to tab identity.
actual: Requests completed before the loading callback's relay/tap injection are not observed and cannot be recovered. Once the loading callback sets `accepting = true`, a late old-document response can pass the replay's tab-only filter because the relay stamps tab_id but no document identity. If URL/method/body identity match and the old document's local request_sequence sorts later, its rows can be selected as current output.
source_evidence: src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts:361-365 filters by tab id, then :444-466 arms acceptance on the loading callback and injects relay/tap sequentially; :476-484 reports no-match only after the capture window.
src/lib/background/bootstrap.ts:551-556 stamps sender.tab.id and rebroadcasts without trusted document identity.
src/lib/data-pattern/network-tap.ts:14-33 event schema has tab_id and a document-local request_sequence but no document identity; :85,159-161 starts the sequence per injected document.
severity: S2: important; replay can miss intended initial data or return stale data from the prior document.
priority: P1: saved Network replay must identify the intended request and source document.
